context: Tests a Swift library release with App-signed version files, SwiftPM tag distribution, CocoaPods publication, metadata-only immutable GitHub Release, and state-specific recovery.

checklist.name: Swift verification
checklist.description: The read-only verify job runs the repository's Swift tests plus podspec validation before release.

checklist.name: Deterministic version prepare
checklist.description: A narrow prepare script validates and updates the existing Package.swift and OrbitKit.podspec to exactly nextRelease.version.

checklist.name: Semantic plugin order
checklist.description: Commit analysis and notes precede exec prepare/publish; the GitHub commit plugin follows prepare and precedes @semantic-release/github.

checklist.name: App-signed version commit
checklist.description: @jno21/semantic-release-github-commit@1.0.1 commits only Package.swift and OrbitKit.podspec with commitMessage containing [skip ci], using a scoped App token and no custom identity.

checklist.name: Head stability
checklist.description: The release rejects a superseded run when live main differs from the analyzed workflow SHA, so the commit plugin cannot absorb unanalyzed concurrent pushes.

checklist.name: Credential boundary
checklist.description: The release Environment contains the App credentials and CocoaPods token; checkout does not persist write credentials and secrets are step-scoped after verification.

checklist.name: CocoaPods publication
checklist.description: A narrow publish script runs pod trunk push OrbitKit.podspec and verifies the exact version exists on trunk.

checklist.name: Immutable metadata release
checklist.description: @semantic-release/github is the sole GitHub Release owner, appends no assets after publication, and completion requires immutable: true plus gh release verify.

checklist.name: Tag and version parity
checklist.description: The tag points to the verified version commit and both checked-in version strings plus the podspec source tag equal the release version.

checklist.name: State-specific backfill
checklist.description: Validated exact-tag recovery publishes only a missing pod or missing GitHub Release, rejects inconsistent state, never creates another bump, and does not rely on a normal semantic-release rerun.

checklist.name: Live completion proof
checklist.description: Initial and recovery paths reread commit verification, default-branch versions, tag target, CocoaPods version, GitHub immutability, release verification, and parity.

checklist.name: Release guardrails
checklist.description: Release uses full history, skip-ci guards on verify/release, non-cancellable release concurrency, and full-SHA high-trust action pins.

checklist.name: No unsigned escape
checklist.description: No local git commit/push, GPG workaround, custom bot identity, second writeback job, or destructive tag/release retry is introduced.
